description: This donut chart, titled “Modality Distribution” from the paper MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio, Music, and Their Mix, visually represents the proportional breakdown of six distinct modalities within the dataset. The chart is composed of six slices, each labeled with its category and percentage. The largest segment is “Speech” at 29.4%, followed by “Mix-Sound-Speech” at 21.8%, “Music” at 20.6%, “Sound” at 16.5%, “Mix-Music-Speech” at 8.2%, and the smallest segment is “Mix-Sound-Music” at 1.1%. The chart uses a color scheme of varying shades of purple, with the “Speech” segment being the darkest and the “Mix-Sound-Music” segment the lightest. All percentage values are clearly labeled within their respective slices, and the chart features a white circular hole in the center, characteristic of a donut chart. The segments are arranged in a clockwise descending order by size, starting from the largest “Speech” segment at the top right.
